Baking the AXP2101 before reflow does not affect the switched 5V rail's converter, loads, GPIO control, or operating pattern.

The AXP2101 pre-reflow baking instruction does not alter the panel button connector, signal connection, or power-control behavior.
The source concerns AXP2101 moisture handling during assembly and does not change ESP32 decoupling values or placement.
The AXP2101 baking requirement has no necessary effect on the battery connector series, mounting type, or pinout.
